whatIs: ForgeUI is a collection of components, blocks and illustrations for React and Tailwind, based on shadcn/ui and with animations built with Motion and GSAP. Part of the catalog is free and installs with the shadcn CLI; the rest and the complete Next.js templates are part of the Pro plan.
It's a good fit when you're building a landing page or a SaaS and want animated marketing blocks that you can edit as your own code.
uses: Installing a free animated form with a shadcn CLI command.
Building a SaaS landing page by combining marketing blocks.
Starting from a complete Next.js template for a product site.
caveats: The animations use Motion and GSAP, so they add those dependencies to your project.
You can't resell or share the Pro content, even modified.
Pro purchases are final and non-refundable, so it's worth trying the free components first.
pricingNote: Part of the catalog is free; Pro is a one-time payment of $99.
idealFor: Landing pages and SaaS products with React and Tailwind that want animated blocks.
